# Beatrix Coull

Sales and technical miller at Tarnwick Mill, the stone-ground mill that has supplied our bread flours since 2025-07-01.

## Role

She handles orders and the technical side: protein and moisture figures for each batch, and advice when a new harvest behaves differently. She ran the mill tour on [[tarnwick-mill-visit-2025-03-19]] and sent the trial sacks for [[flour-bake-trial-2025-05-14]].

## How we work together

- Orders by email on Monday evening for Tuesday and Friday delivery ([[supplier-order-calendar]]).
- She phones Kofi directly when a new harvest comes in, usually late September, with a note on water uptake. Kofi adjusts hydration by one or two points.
- The mill holds two weeks of our flour as a buffer, which was her offer and the reason the small-mill risk felt acceptable.

## Current threads

- Agreement renewed to 2027-06-30 at +4% ([[tarnwick-mill-supply-agreement-2025]]).
- Whether Tarnwick will mill a finer pastry grade worth trialling ([[should-pastry-flour-move-to-tarnwick]]).
- She is interested in heritage wheat trials; I said not before 2027 ([[heritage-grains]]).
